name: Hotel Restaurant Stern
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hotel Restaurant Stern in Ehrwald**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps** in **Tirol**, **Ehrwald** is the perfect starting point for unforgettable adventures in nature. Our **Hotel Restaurant Stern** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy mountain atmosphere.

### **A Culinary Journey Through Tirol**
Indulge in our traditional Tyrolean dishes, crafted with local ingredients. Start your day with a hearty breakfast featuring fresh bread, homemade jams, and regional specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Speckknödel**. For lunch, savor classic mountain cuisine such as **Tiroler Gröstl**, **Käsespätzle**, or a juicy **Tafelspitz** with **Tiroler Bergkäse** sauce.

In the evening, enjoy our **Hausmannskost** (homestyle cooking) with dishes like **Schweinsbraten** with **Krautsalat** and **Semmelknödel**, or a delicious **Wildgulasch** with **Tiroler Graukäse** dumplings. Don’t miss our **Apfelstrudel** with vanilla sauce—a true sweet treat!

### **Wine & Beer from Tirol**
Pair your meal with fine **Tiroler wines** or a refreshing **Tiroler Bier** from local breweries. Our selection includes crisp whites like **Silvaner** and robust reds such as **Blaufränkisch**, as well as traditional **Tiroler Bergkristall** beers.

### **Relax & Enjoy**
After your meal, unwind in our cozy lounge with panoramic views of the **Zillertal Valley** and the surrounding peaks. Whether you’re planning a hike to the **Ahornspitze**, a ski day in **Hahnenkamm**, or a relaxing spa visit in **Innsbruck**, we’re your perfect home base.

### **Events & Special Occasions**
Celebrate with us! Our **Sternstunden** (special evenings) feature live music, fondue nights, or themed dinners. We also offer private events for weddings, anniversaries, or business meetings in our elegant **Almwiesen** or **Bergblick** rooms.

### **Your Gateway to Tirol’s Adventures**
Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Ehrwald** is the ideal starting point for exploring **Tirol’s** natural wonders. Whether you’re skiing in **Mayrhofen**, mountain biking in **Zillertal**, or simply soaking in the alpine air, **Hotel Restaurant Stern** ensures a warm welcome and unforgettable experiences.

**We look forward to welcoming you in Ehrwald!**
